title: Identify, Classify, Act: Per-Instruction Controlled Compliance for LLMs over External Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.22874v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs over external data face a per-instruction tension: a single document or tool return often interleaves legitimate directives with adversarial prompt injections, and the model must follow the former while rejecting the latter. Existing defenses suppress or trust all external instructions, collapsing the safety-utility frontier and forcing a choice between over-refusal and over-compliance. We argue the missing capability is \textbf{per-instruction credit attribution} and formalize it as External-Data Instruction Classification, an identify-classify-act decision over each embedded directive. We propose \textbf{EDIC}, a decomposed reward framework for per-instruction compliance. A scene-grounded pipeline injects mixed beneficial and harmful instructions with counterfactual filtering, while a generative judge is initialized by SFT and refined with GRPO to attribute compliance at the instruction level. translated_title: 识别、分类、行动：面向外部数据的LLM逐指令受控合规
translated_abstract: 基于外部数据的大语言模型面临逐指令层面的张力：单个文档或工具返回结果常常将合法指令与对抗性提示注入交织在一起，模型必须遵循前者同时拒绝后者。现有防御措施要么压制所有外部指令，要么信任所有外部指令，导致安全-效用边界坍缩，迫使人们在不当拒绝与过度服从之间做出选择。我们认为缺失的能力是逐指令功劳归因，并将其形式化为外部数据指令分类，即对每条嵌入指令进行识别-分类-行动的决策过程。我们提出EDIC，一个用于逐指令合规的分解式奖励框架。一个基于场景的流水线通过反事实过滤注入混合的有益与有害指令，同时一个生成式评判者通过SFT初始化并经GRPO优化，以在指令级别归因合规性。评判者随后产生一个奖励……
tldr: 提出EDIC分解式奖励框架，通过对外部数据中每条嵌入指令进行识别-分类-行动决策，并利用基于场景的指令注入和SFT加GRPO训练的生成式评判者实现指令级功劳归因，使LLM能够遵循合法指令的同时拒绝对抗性提示注入。
en_tdlr: EDIC, a decomposed reward framework performing identify-classify-act decisions on each embedded instruction in external data, uses a scene-grounded injection pipeline and an SFT-initialized, GRPO-refined generative judge for instruction-level credit attribution, enabling LLMs to follow legitimate directives while rejecting adversarial prompt injections.
